$why: The addresses this repository may name, each with the files that may name it and why. Read by scripts/check-addresses.ts; an entry that admits nothing fails, so the list carries no standing permission.

allow.why: Google Meet, a vendor the roster integrates: a class's meeting link is built on this host from its meeting code.
Google Classroom, a vendor the roster integrates: a course's link and its join link are on this host.
Google's sign-in page, named in the teacher account mail's steps for adding the school-issued account.
Google's API scopes are URLs on this host (Calendar, Classroom, Directory); a scope is its name.
PayPal, a vendor the roster integrates: a payment's receipt link is on this host.
Zelle, a vendor the roster integrates: the QR code a family scans to pay carries this host.
The Apache License 2.0 text and its pointer.
The secret scanner's pinned release (gitleaks), fetched by CI and checked against its SHA-256.
The npm registry the lockfile resolves every package from (its `resolved` fields, the only lines of the lockfile the gate reads).
